description.zh: 按住右键画一下：后退、关窗口、切标签页；选中文字后画一下或按快捷键：复制、搜索、翻译；画个圈、推到屏幕角落、在屏幕边上来回蹭、按住右键滚滚轮，都能设成按键、打开程序、输入文字或关机重启。可以只在某个程序里、某个角落里生效。管理员身份运行的窗口里用不了
description.en: Hold the right button and draw: back, close the window, switch tabs. Select words, then draw or press a shortcut: copy, search, translate. Circles, the screen's corners and edges, and the wheel with the right button held can press keys, open programs, type text, shut down or restart. A rule can hold in one program or one corner only. Not in windows run as administrator

notes.zh: 选中文字后按快捷键：在设置窗口“选中文字时”一页下面录一个快捷键（比如 Ctrl+Alt+T），选中文字按它就翻译，动作也可以改成复制、网页搜索等；浏览器、VS Code、微信里也能用（Win顺 替你按一下 Ctrl+C，读完马上把剪贴板放回去，Win顺 自己的剪贴板历史里不会多一条；在浏览器里用要 Win顺 0.42.0）。修好了在浏览器里按住右键滚滚轮切标签页时，第二下起不再切换的问题。权限不变。
notes.en: A shortcut for selected text: record one at the bottom of the 选中文字时 page of the settings window (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+T); select text and press it to translate, or have it copy, search the web and so on. It works in browsers, VS Code and WeChat too (WinShun presses Ctrl+C for you and puts the clipboard back at once, with no new entry in its own clipboard history; browsers need WinShun 0.42.0). Fixed: with the right button held over a browser, the wheel switched the tab only on its first notch. Permissions unchanged.
